text:
maya: Morning — finalizing the newsletter sequence for our benchmark webinar next month. Need quick alignment on segments, send windows, and inbound routing. @jordan can you confirm the enterprise segment criteria? Also want a concise benchmark narrative in email #2 (one para). Thoughts? :coffee:

jordan: On it. Current enterprise segment rule we're using is ARR > $250k OR seats > 200 AND HQ in NA/EU. Pasting the SQL we use below so Sam can map routing.

jordan: ```sql
SELECT account_id FROM accounts
WHERE (annual_recurring_revenue > 250000 OR employee_count > 200)
AND region IN ('NA','EU')
AND last_seen > now() - interval '12 months';
```

sam: Routing plan draft: enterprise -> sales-enterprise (round-robin AEs), mid-market -> sdr-nurture queue, startup -> product-led nurture. Webinar registrants go to webinar-nurture flow; if intent_score > 70 then assign AE and create task.

leo: For email #2 (benchmark narrative) I recommend 2 short lead lines: 1) "What we measured: avg latency + cost per token across 3 models" and 2) a one-sentence hook with concrete numbers. Subject line test ideas: A) "How we cut inference costs 3x — benchmark + live demo" B) "Real-world latency wins from our inference stack (benchmarks inside)"

katie: Send windows: prefer Wed/Thu. Suggest: NA/SA at 09:00 local, EU at 10:00 local, APAC at 10:30 SGT. CSV export for calendar import: 

katie: ```csv
region,local_send_time,notes
NA,09:00,EST/PST staggered
EU,10:00,CET
APAC,10:30,SGT/JST
```

nora: Add privacy check: include a clear opt-in for webinar follow-up on the registration form and flag registrants who want sales contact. Also confirm GDPR lawful basis for personalized follow-ups.

launch-bot: Campaign draft "benchmark-webinar-series" created by maya. Scheduled window: 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC (provisional).

maya: Great — action items: @jordan drop final SQL and sample segment size, @sam finalize routing doc with queue names, @leo finalize two subject lines + 2 preview texts, @katie push sends to calendar and create campaign in martech, @nora confirm privacy wording. I'll assemble the one-paragraph benchmark narrative after Jordan shares numbers. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
